notes: No renderer release delivered. All capabilities remain proposed until real build/release evidence is attached.

capabilities.description: Base renderer: view box, layers, group, transforms, opacity, palette tokens, named states, state conditions, transitions, reduced-motion still, preview frames.
SVG path subset: M L H V C Q Z (absolute and relative), max 400 commands per layer.
Linear and radial gradient fills, max 4 stops.
Clip a group by a rect, ellipse, or path layer.
Placed static SVG asset (no scripts, no text, no external references).
Keyframe tracks on translate_x, translate_y, rotation, scale, opacity; easing linear/ease_in/ease_out/ease_in_out; loop none/repeat/ping_pong.
Named anchor points for hotspots and overlays.
Bounded procedural twinkle field inside a rect (count <= 40, deterministic seed).
Flowing water ripple band. Not yet implemented; content using it cannot be published.

anchor_motion.applies_to: descendants of an anchored layer; the anchored layer and its ancestors must have no position-changing tracks or state rules

performance_target.device_class: mid-range Android (2021, e.g. 4 GB RAM, Snapdragon 7-series) and iPhone 11
performance_target.measured_by: tools/scene_preview --benchmark on the reference devices in CI device farm
